note: Where people can be in a place picture, shared by all its light and weather versions (each checked to share the midday picture's camera). Percent of the picture (1672 x 941). Each spot is a foot point with a pose (stand, sit, podium, lean), a facing (viewer, left, right) and a draw depth (0 farthest); a seat also has seatY (the cushion top), a podium its audience side, seats at one desk or table share a group, and a spot behind a desk, counter or lectern has clipBelowY, below which nothing is drawn. A person's height is 1.7 m x metersPercent x (y - horizonY) percent of the picture; a raised floor (stage, dais, bench, steps, porch) keeps the horizon and has its own metersPercent under floors. One spot per place is the hero spot, where the main character stands on the title screen. Measured by eye on Sept. 28, 2026 from a 5% grid and zoomed crops, scale from painted objects of known size (measuredFrom), and checked by drawing engine people on every spot. Session 11 audit on October 5, 2026: added furniture positions are visual estimates from native midday paintings (about 1-2 percentage points uncertainty, larger on hidden floors); existing measured floor scales retained. Facing away marks real chairs awaiting rear-view people art, never a front-view substitute. See docs/art/seating-audit.md. Standing scene role tags distinguish physical eligibility from attendance; generic furniture grants no authority. Surface slots reference the existing measured surface registry; position/size are native-pixel bounds of its midday quad, not new measurements or approvals.
